pages.text: You can permanently modify your haulers by combining them with special materials in any $(2)Crafting Table$(). Since these are applied shapelessly, simply place your hauler and the material anywhere in the grid.

pages.title: Reinforced
pages.text: Adding any $(2)Iron Ingot$() to your hauler increases its maximum durability, allowing it to withstand $(2)12 MAX Integrity() instead of the standard 8. Crucial for carrying heavy loads.

pages.title: Aerodynamic
pages.text: Stitching a $(2)Phantom Membrane$() to the fabric optimizes the airflow, providing the hauler with a passive $(2)+25% speed bonus$() on all flights.

pages.title: Waxed
pages.text: Coating the balloon with a $(2)Honeycomb$() waterproofs the entire structure, preventing double durability wear when flying through $(2)Rain$().

pages.title: Insulated
pages.text: Wiring a $(2)Lightning Rod$() into the basket protects the sensitive navigation systems, making the hauler immune to damage from $(2)Thunderstorms$().

pages.title: Buoyancy
pages.text: Installing a $(2)Shulker Shell$() grants the balloon anti-gravity properties. This effectively $(2)reduces the cargo's Weight Tier by 1$(), allowing massive loads to fly as if they were much lighter.

pages.title: Shock Absorbers
pages.text: Adding a $(2)Slime Block$() creates shock absorbers for the basket. This $(2)completely negates impact damage$() when heavy or overloaded haulers crash down onto the dock.

pages.title: Supercharged
pages.text: Integrating a $(2)Magma Block$() creates a Supercharged Burner. This $(2)increases your fuel tier by 1$(), meaning basic Coal will grant the extreme lifting power of Blaze Powder.

pages.title: Netherite Plating
pages.text: Forging a $(2)Netherite Ingot$() onto the frame creates the ultimate hauler. This heavy plating extends the maximum durability to a massive $(2)32 MAX Integrity().$(br)$(br)Note: The hauler must already have the $(2)Reinforced$() upgrade to accept this.
